title: Upcycling E-waste for sustainable innovation: functional materials, toxicity reduction, and circular design
content:

Upcycling e-waste converts discarded electronics into high-value catalysts, electrodes, and sensors using green, bio-assisted recovery, reducing toxicity and promoting circular, sustainable material innovation aligned with global goals.
